summary: Built a teacher-first static worksheet library with exact-grade filtering, search, format choices, and 139 deterministic K-12 math worksheet types.

commands_run.notes: Checked 139 worksheet types and 834 generated items with no failed audits.
Harness validation passed; it reported warnings for ready tasks sharing .agent/reports and for the manual result status not being reflected in .agent/state.json.

acceptance_results.criterion: Teachers can filter worksheet types by exact grade from Pre-K/K through grade 12
acceptance_results.notes: Added exact-grade filter controls for Pre-K, K, and grades 1-12.

acceptance_results.criterion: Search and grade/type filters work together without removing the current printable worksheet preview
acceptance_results.notes: Search, exact grade, grade band, strand, and format filters combine in getFilteredTypes while the worksheet preview remains rendered.

acceptance_results.criterion: Clicking a worksheet type exposes multiple worksheet format choices and regenerates the preview in the chosen format
acceptance_results.notes: Selected generator panel now shows available formats; selecting a format updates worksheet metadata and format-specific layout classes.

acceptance_results.criterion: Worksheet inventory includes at least 90 generator entries across K-12 math
acceptance_results.notes: Inventory now contains 139 unique worksheet type ids across K-12.

acceptance_results.criterion: The static app still runs by opening index.html without an install step
acceptance_results.notes: No package or dependency step was added; app remains static HTML/CSS/JS.

acceptance_results.criterion: Generator verification passes for every worksheet type
acceptance_results.notes: node scripts/verify-generators.js passed for 139 worksheet types and 834 generated items.

risks: Many new worksheet types currently reuse the closest existing deterministic generator kind; future tasks should add more specialized problem generators for richer prompt variety.
